purpose: First Real Model-Optimization Experiment: Feature Selection (k=50,100,200,500) & Class-Weight Balancing

final_test.message: Final test evaluation not performed during this optimization run.

optimization_findings.class_balancing_impact: Increased ADHD sensitivity from 0.1000 to 0.7000 and F1 from 0.1538 to 0.7000 on validation.
optimization_findings.feature_k_impact: K=50 and K=100 outperformed K=200/500, which overfit to high-dimensional connectivity noise.
